gate_tiers.strict: Pose RMSD <=2.5 A, interface PAE <=1.5 A, binder pLDDT >=80.
gate_tiers.relaxed: Pose RMSD <=3 A, interface PAE <=3 A, binder pLDDT >=75.
gate_tiers.both: At least two central-peptide contacts and C-terminal tag clearance >=8 A.

limitations: One Protenix seed/sample per reviewed candidate.
No WT or empty-HLA predictions for the reviewed candidates.
Computational filters, not experimental binding or specificity.
